service: Firebase Test Lab, physical device, Robo test with a Robo script

testLab.note: The script's WAIT_FOR_ELEMENT never matched the 'nano-check-finished' label (it was below the fold, and Robo only matches on-screen elements), so the session idled on the result screen until the 12-minute wait ran out. Fixed in src/app/nano-check.tsx in the main working tree (label moved into the top card).

build.apk: android-release-apk artifact of GitHub Actions run 45609966736 (branch ci/mobile-smoke, commit a33c7a7)
build.type: release, signed with the debug key from expo prebuild

result.aicoreReason: AICore gave no usable model. The Firebase on-device SDK returned UNAVAILABLE in about 10 ms with no bind attempt logged; the system logged 'PlatformConfigurator: Retried propagating for com.google.android.platform.aicore 5 times without succeeding' and 'PhenotypeResourceReader: unable to find any Phenotype resource metadata for com.google.android.aicore'.
result.download: not offered (status was unavailable, not downloadable)

prompt.errorMessage: On-device AI is not ready on this device (unavailable).
prompt.sourceLabel: on_device (intended leg; the orchestrator refused, no model ran)
prompt.cloudFallback: none: the orchestrator did not send the only_on_device request to the cloud

result.appCheck: not_configured: Firebase was never initialised because the orchestrator refused before the provider, so no App Check token was requested

files.logcat-aicore.txt: every logcat line that mentions AICore in the same session
